entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Ashok Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Raj Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Aashu alias Mahendra Pal with the prayer to quash the impugned order dated 29.9.2022 passed by the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Varanasi (Annexure No. 6) and further be pleased to direct the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Varanasi to hear and decide the Discharge Application of the applicant and with further prayer to stay the impugned order dated 29.9.2022 passed by the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Varanasi (Annexure No. 6) and further be pleased to stay the entire proceedings of Case Crime No.
1082/2018, under Sections 498A, 504 I.P.C. Case No. 10984 of 2019, State vs. Aashu alias Aashu @ Mahendra Pal vs State Of U.P And Another on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110705503/
1 Mahendra, pending before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Varanasi, during pendency of the present application.

entities.text: State vs. Aashu alias Aashu @ Mahendra Pal vs State Of U.P And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has advanced his arguments at length after which the matter was being decided and an order was being dictated and then he states that the present application be dismissed as withdrawn.
The present application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 19.1.2023 Naresh  Aashu @ Mahendra Pal vs State Of U.P And Another on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110705503/
